# Sensitivity Analysis 3: model 1 for only visit 1 to visit 3

```{r Model1_v1_v3, include = FALSE}

NeuroMETs3 <- NeuroMET %>% filter (visit %in% c("t1", "t2", "t3"))

lmer_long_glu_groupwise_s3 <- lmer(glu ~ diagnose_group * year + ns(age_bl, df = 2) + sex + (1|record_id), data = NeuroMETs3,REML = TRUE, na.action = na.omit, weights = glu_inv_aCRLB)
#test for best fit
# lmer_long_glu_groupwise_2_s3 <- lmer(glu ~ diagnose_group * year + ns(age_bl, df = 3) + sex + (1|record_id),
#        data = NeuroMETs3,REML = TRUE, na.action = na.omit, weights = glu_inv_aCRLB)
# anova(lmer_long_glu_groupwise_s3, lmer_long_glu_groupwise_2_s3)


lmer_long_gaba_groupwise_s3 <- lmer(gaba ~ diagnose_group * year + ns(age_bl, df = 1) + sex+ (1|record_id),
       data = NeuroMETs3,REML = TRUE, na.action = na.omit, weights = gaba_inv_aCRLB)
#test for best fit

# anova(lmer_long_gaba_groupwise_s3 , lmer_long_gaba_groupwise_2_s3)


lmer_long_glu_gaba_groupwise_s3   <- lmer(glu_gaba ~ diagnose_group * year + ns(age_bl, df = 1) + sex+ (1|record_id), data = NeuroMETs3,REML = TRUE, na.action = na.omit, weights = w_log_glu_gaba_ratio)
#test for best fit

```{r stdcoeffs_s3, results = 'hide', warning = FALSE}

##standardized primary results
glu_slopes_s3 <- emtrends(lmer_long_glu_groupwise_s3, var = "year", specs = ~ diagnose_group, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),data = NeuroMETs3)%>%  # infer = CI + test
              as.data.frame()

gaba_slopes_s3 <- emtrends(lmer_long_gaba_groupwise_s3, var = "year", specs = ~ diagnose_group, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),data = NeuroMETs3)%>%  # infer = CI + test
              as.data.frame()

glu_gaba_slopes_s3 <- emtrends(lmer_long_glu_gaba_groupwise_s3, var = "year", specs = ~ diagnose_group, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),data = NeuroMETs3)%>%  # infer = CI + test
              as.data.frame()

glu_slopes_df_s3 <- glu_slopes_s3 %>%
  mutate(std_beta    = year.trend / sd_glu_cn_neg, std_lower.CL = lower.CL   / sd_glu_cn_neg,
         std_upper.CL = upper.CL   / sd_glu_cn_neg)  #sd_glu_cn_neg is the same for NeuroMET and NeuroMETs
gaba_slopes_df_s3 <- gaba_slopes_s3 %>%
  mutate(std_beta    = year.trend / sd_gaba_cn_neg, std_lower.CL = lower.CL   / sd_gaba_cn_neg,
         std_upper.CL = upper.CL   / sd_gaba_cn_neg)
glu_gaba_slopes_df_s3 <- glu_gaba_slopes_s3 %>%
  mutate(std_beta    = year.trend / sd_glu_gaba_cn_neg, std_lower.CL = lower.CL   / sd_glu_gaba_cn_neg,
         std_upper.CL = upper.CL   / sd_glu_gaba_cn_neg)

```


```{r FigS4, fig.align = "center", warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,  results = "asis", fig.height = 8, fig.width=10, fig.cap= "**Fig. S4. Sensitivity analyses 2 of group comparisons of longitudinal changes of 7T MRS neurotransmitter concentrations.** After removing all data points of the 4- and 5-year visits, the estimated glutamate trajectories strengthened in all groups, with the decline in AD Aβ+ group reaching significance. While the GABA increase in the MCI Aβ+ group increased in effect size, the decline of log(glutamate/GABA) ratio in the CN Aβ- group lost significance. Other longitudinal trajectories showed no meaningful differences from the primary analysis. All models were weighted based on Cramér–Rao lower bounds (CRLB), a common metric for quantifying uncertainty in MRS, with datapoint size in this figure reflecting the corresponding model weight; smaller datapoints indicate higher uncertainty (i.e., higher CLRBs). Amyloid-β positivity (Aβ +) was defined based on plasma p-Tau181, as indicated by the orange points. Displayed β coefficients and p-values indicate estimated annual change per group, based on estimated marginal trends. *Abbreviations: AD = Alzheimer’s disease, Aβ = amyloid-beta, CN = cognitively normal, CRLB = Cramér-Rao lower bound, GABA = gamma-aminobutyric acid, MCI = mild cognitive impairment, MRS = magnetic resonance spectroscopy.* "}

# Model Glutamate
# Define new data grid
new_data_glu_year <- expand.grid(
  year = seq(min(NeuroMETs3$year, na.rm = TRUE), max(NeuroMETs3$year, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100),
  diagnose_group = levels(factor(NeuroMETs3$diagnose_group)),
  age_bl = mean(NeuroMETs3$age_bl, na.rm = TRUE), # Fixed age at mean
  sex = as.factor(1)   # or change to "male" or both if needed
)

label_positions <- new_data_glu_year %>%
  group_by(diagnose_group) %>%
  summarise(x = max(year), y = 17.75, .groups = "drop")
coef_glu <- data.frame(emtrends(lmer_long_glu_groupwise_s3, ~ diagnose_group, var = "year", data = NeuroMETs3)) %>% mutate(label = paste0("β = ", sprintf("%.2f",year.trend), " [",  sprintf("%.2f",lower.CL), "; ", sprintf("%.2f", upper.CL), "]\n", "p = ", sprintf("%.3f",(emtrends(lmer_long_glu_groupwise_s3, ~ diagnose_group, var = "year", data = NeuroMETs3)%>% test())$p.value))) %>% select(diagnose_group, label)%>%
  left_join(label_positions, by = "diagnose_group")

# Predict values
preds <- predict(lmer_long_glu_groupwise_s3, newdata = new_data_glu_year, re.form = NA, se.fit = TRUE)

# Store predictions and confidence intervals
new_data_glu_year$pred <- preds$fit
new_data_glu_year$lower <- preds$fit - 1.96 * preds$se.fit
new_data_glu_year$upper <- preds$fit + 1.96 * preds$se.fit

p1 <- ggplot(new_data_glu_year, aes(x = year, y = pred, color = diagnose_group)) +
 
  geom_line(data=NeuroMETs3 %>% filter(!is.na(diagnose_group) & !is.na(glu)), 
            aes(x = year, y = glu, group=record_id, color=diagnose_group), alpha=0.5) +
  # geom_point(data=NeuroMETs3 %>% filter(!is.na(diagnose_group) & !is.na(glu)), 
  #            aes(x = year, y = glu, group=record_id, color=diagnose_group, size = glu_CRLB), alpha=0.5) +
  geom_point(data=NeuroMETs3 %>% filter(!is.na(pTau_group)), aes(x = year, y = glu, color = pTau_group, size = glu_CRLB),  alpha = 0.8)+
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = diagnose_group), linetype = 0, alpha = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Glutamate [mmol/L]",
       color = "Clinical Diagnosis at visit 1",
       fill = "Clinical Diagnosis at visit 1") +
  facet_wrap(~diagnose_group, nrow = 1) +  
  geom_text(data = coef_glu, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), color = "black", hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 3)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c(diagnose_colors, diagnose_colors[4], diagnose_colors[1])) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c(diagnose_colors, diagnose_colors[4], diagnose_colors[1])) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.8, 2.5), name = "CRLB-based size") +  # optional legend
  guides(fill= "none") +
  #theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = 'top', 
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85",colour = NA),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        axis.ticks.x= element_line(colour = "black"))



# Model GABA

# Define new data grid
new_data_gaba_year <- expand.grid(

  scale_fill_manual(values=c(diagnose_colors, diagnose_colors[4], diagnose_colors[1])) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.8, 2.5), name = "CRLB-based size") +  # optional legend
  guides(fill= "none", size = "none") +

            strip.background = element_blank(),
            strip.text.x = element_blank(),
